newsitem.title: USA: Big City Bagels lowers warrant exercise prices.
newsitem.headline: Big City Bagels lowers warrant exercise prices.

text.p: Big City Bagels Inc said on Thursday that effective July 11 it will reduce the exercise price of its class A and B redeemable common stock purchase warrants.

The company will reduce the exercise price on the class A warrants to $2.50 per share for a period of 60 days from the present $4.50 per share. This special exercise period will last until September 8 or it may be extended for up to an additional 30 days at the company's discretion.
If the class A warrants are exercised prior to the expiration of the special exercise period, the warrant holder will be issued a new class A warrant at the end of the special exercise period.

If an aggregate of at least $2,000,000 of gross proceeds come from the exercise of the class A warrants during this special period, the exercise price of the class A warrants which are not exercised and the new class A warrants will remain at $2.50 per share until their expiration on May 6, 2000.

If at least $2,000,000 of gross proceeds are not derived from the exercise of the class A warrants during this special period, then the exercise price of the class A warrants and the new class A warrants will be $4.50 after the special period.

In addition, the company will also reduce the exercise price of its class B warrants to $2.50 per share and will not require two class B warrants to be exercised in tandem to receive one share of common stock.
If exercised, each class B warrant will entitle the holder to purchase one share of common stock for $2.50 per share and the receive a new class A warrant after the special period.

After the special period, the exercise price of the class B warrants will return to the original terms, which require two class B warrants to be exercised in tandem with an aggregate exercise price of $8 per share of common stock.
Big City Bagels operates and franchises bakery cafes.
